classification.difficultyReason: Substantial transfer, coordinated cases or justification beyond a direct worked-example substitution. Page 51 demonstrates staged set operations. The second union excludes only -2, which must remain a hole in the left component.

content.prompt: Sketch the following on the number line. $$\big((-\infty,-1)\cup(1,\infty)\big)\cap\big((-\infty,-2)\cup(-2,\infty)\big)$$

answer.worked:
The second union contains every real number except $-2$. Its intersection with the first union therefore removes $-2$:
$$(-\infty,-2)\cup(-2,-1)\cup(1,\infty).$$
Draw the left ray ending open at $-1$, with an open hole at $-2$, and a separate right ray starting open at $1$.
